tests.title: CSS-contain test: layout containment and forced breaks
tests.assertion: forced breaks within layout containment do not propagate to the parent.
tests.spec_link:
http://www.gtalbot.org/BrowserBugsSection/css21testsuite/">
  <meta content="forced breaks within layout containment do not propagate to the parent." name="assert">

  <link href="reference/contain-layout-breaks-002-ref.html" rel="match">

  <link href=
tests.propagation_fact: A forced break inside a layout-contained child does not propagate to its parent; the parent's column layout is unaffected.

tests.title: CSS Test: Margins should not propagate into the next page
tests.propagation_fact: A huge bottom margin before a page break does not propagate onto the next page; content on the following page stays at the top.

tests.title: CSS Test: Overflow affect on children
tests.assertion: Overflow clipping does not affect elements which are ancestors to the element being clipped.
tests.propagation_fact: Clipping an element's overflow does not move or alter its ancestor elements.

tests.title: CSS Test: Overflow hidden on root element
tests.assertion: Clipping does not affect elements where their parent is the viewport.
tests.propagation_fact: Overflow clipping does not affect an element whose parent is the viewport.

tests.title: position:sticky elements should not affect the flow position of other elements
tests.assertion: This test checks that position:sticky elements do not affect the flow position of other elements
tests.propagation_fact: A sticky-positioned element's stickiness does not change the flow positions of the other elements around it.

tests.title: CSS Overflow: line-clamp doesn't propagate to abspos
tests.assertion: Absolute positioned boxes create a new BFC, and line-clamp does not propagate into independent BFCs
tests.propagation_fact: line-clamp on a container does not propagate into absolutely positioned descendants, which form independent BFCs.

tests.title: CSS Overflow: line-clamp doesn't propagate to floats
tests.assertion: Floats create a new BFC, and line-clamp does not propagate into independent BFCs
tests.propagation_fact: line-clamp on a container does not propagate into floated boxes, which form independent BFCs.

tests.title: CSS Overflow: No clearance if block-ellipsis fits
tests.assertion: After displacing content to make room for the ellipsis, if the line would fit next to a float, keep and there and do not shift it down.
tests.propagation_fact: Inserting the block-ellipsis does not shift the line down when the line fits beside a float.

tests.title: CSS Overflow: when clamping by lines, margins of hidden boxes are ignored
tests.assertion: When line-clamp is used with a number of lines, the margins of boxes after the clamp point should not affect the sizing of boxes.
tests.propagation_fact: Margins of boxes hidden after the line-clamp point do not change the clamped container's size.

tests.title: CSS Position: Large negative box inset properties
tests.assertion: This test verifies a box with very large negative insets within an element with will-change: transform does not affect the rendering of the element.
tests.propagation_fact: An absolutely positioned descendant with very large negative insets does not alter the rendering of its will-change: transform ancestor.

tests.title: CSS Test: Absolute positions impact on later siblings
tests.assertion: Absolute positioned elements do not impact later siblings.
tests.propagation_fact: Absolutely positioning an element does not impact its later in-flow siblings' positions.

tests.title: CSS Multi-column Layout Test: Restyle column-span's parent that is a block
tests.assertion: This test checks change the style of the spanner
tests.propagation_fact: Changing the style of a spanner's parent does not affect the spanner's rendering.

tests.title: CSS Multi-column Layout Test: multi-column and margin bottom of last child
tests.assertion: This test checks the margin-bottom of the last child of a multi-column should not affect its parent
tests.propagation_fact: The last child of a multi-column element's bottom margin does not affect its parent's bottom margin.

tests.title: CSS Grid: grid gutters and tracks.
tests.assertion: Check that gutters contribute to the size of the grid containers and spanning items, and do not alter grid items positioning, margin computation and track sizing.
tests.propagation_fact: Changing grid gutters grows the grid container and spanning items but does not alter grid item positioning, margin computation, or track sizing.

tests.title: CSS Flexbox: vertical-align on a flex item
tests.assertion: vertical-align should have no effect on a flex item, i.e. flex items
tests.propagation_fact: Setting vertical-align on a flex item does not shift the item's content.

tests.title: CSS Test: flex-container-margin-not-collapse-with-content-margin
tests.assertion: The margins of adjacent flex items do not collapse.
tests.propagation_fact: Adjacent flex items' margins do not collapse, so margins on one item do not reduce the gap before the next item.

tests.title: CSS Grid Layout Test: inline grid's margins do not collapse
tests.assertion: This test checks that inline grid
tests.propagation_fact: An inline grid's margin does not collapse with its grid item's margins, so the item's margins do not move the grid's position.

tests.title: CSS Test: CSS Blocks: Effect of Bottom Padding on Inline Layout
tests.assertion: Bottom padding on inline elements has no effect on layout.
tests.propagation_fact: Adding bottom padding to an inline element has no effect on layout; it does not push following content down.

tests.title: CSS Test: CSS Blocks: Effect of Top Padding on Inline Layout
tests.assertion: Top padding on inline elements has no effect on layout.
tests.propagation_fact: Adding top padding to an inline element has no effect on layout; it does not push preceding content up.

tests.title: CSS Test: min-height prevents child bottom margin from collapsing through parent
tests.assertion: When min-height raises a block
tests.propagation_fact: When min-height raises a block's height above its auto height, the last child's bottom margin does not collapse through the parent.

tests.title: CSS Test: Block formatting context auto height with floated descendants outside the normal flow and bottom margins
tests.assertion: The auto height of a block formatting context element does not account for bottom margins of floated content descendents of out of flow blocks.
tests.propagation_fact: A BFC element's auto height does not account for bottom margins of floated descendants of out-of-flow blocks.

tests.title: CSS Test: Absolutely positioned elements do not establish a new containing block for fixed position descendants
tests.assertion: An absolutely positioned box does not establish a new containing block for fixed positioned descendants.
tests.propagation_fact: An absolutely positioned box does not establish a new containing block for fixed-positioned descendants, so adding absolute positioning to an ancestor does not relocate its fixed descendants.

tests.title: CSS Test: Absolutely positioned elements child behavior
tests.assertion: The contents of an absolutely positioned element do not flow around any other boxes and can obscure the contents of another box.
tests.propagation_fact: The contents of an absolutely positioned element do not flow around any other boxes and can obscure another box's contents.

tests.title: CSS Test: Fixed position elements impact on later siblings
tests.assertion: Fixed positioned elements do not impact later siblings.
tests.propagation_fact: Fixed-positioning an element does not impact its later in-flow siblings' positions.

tests.title: CSS Test: Relative positioning dimensions
tests.assertion: Relative positioning with left or right does not change size of a box.
tests.propagation_fact: Offsetting a box with relative positioning (left/right) does not change the box's own size.

tests.title: CSS Test: Relatively positioned box has no impact on boxes which follow
tests.assertion: Offsetting a box with relative positioning has no effect on the boxes which follow.
tests.propagation_fact: Offsetting a box with relative positioning has no effect on the boxes that follow it.

tests.title: CSS Test: Relatively positioned box has no impact on boxes which follow and boxes may overlap
tests.assertion: Offsetting a box with relative positioning has no effect on the boxes which follow and boxes may overlap.
tests.propagation_fact: Offsetting a box with relative positioning has no effect on the boxes that follow it, and boxes may overlap.

tests.title: CSS Test: Content laid out in normal flow when 'position' is set to 'static'
tests.assertion: Static positioned elements are not affected by top, right, bottom, left property settings.
tests.propagation_fact: A statically positioned element is not affected by top, right, bottom, left property settings; its position does not change.

tests.title: CSS Flexible Box Layout Test: Test flex container's overflow rect
tests.assertion: This test verifies that a flex container
tests.propagation_fact: A flex container's padding rect does not affect its overflow rect at all.

tests.title: margin-trim: block-container-block-end-collapsed-margins
tests.assertion: collapsed block-end margins should be trimmed but not affect container margins
tests.propagation_fact: margin-trim trims collapsed block-end margins without affecting the container's own margins.

tests.title: CSS Test: Margin applied to element with display inline
tests.assertion: The
tests.propagation_fact: Vertical margins on inline non-replaced elements do not apply, so they do not move surrounding content.

tests.title: CSS Test: block-in-inline margin collapses through an intervening float
tests.assertion: A floated box between two block-in-inlines does not consume the preceding block
tests.propagation_fact: A floated box between two block-in-inlines does not consume the preceding block's margin-bottom; it collapses with the following block-in-inline as if the float were not there.

tests.title: CSS Test: block-in-inline at parent start with margin-top collapses with parent
tests.assertion: A block-in-inline
tests.propagation_fact: A block-in-inline's margin-top at the start of its parent collapses with the parent's margin-top and out to its preceding sibling.

tests.title: CSS Overflow: line-clamp ellipsis repaint tests
tests.assertion: This test makes sure that, if the line with the ellipsis gets moved vertically because the height of previous lines grows, the ellipsis moves correspondingly; and that this happens even when the height of the line-clamp container does not change.
tests.propagation_fact: If the line with the ellipsis is moved vertically because the height of previous lines grows, the ellipsis moves correspondingly.

tests.title: CSS Gap Decorations: repaint when flex container position shifts
tests.assertion: Flex column-rule gap decorations break at the row-gap intersections after a preceding sibling shifts the container
tests.propagation_fact: Flex column-rule gap decorations break at the row-gap intersections after a preceding sibling shifts the container's block position, instead of painting through them.

tests.title: Content Visibility: resize observer interactions
tests.assertion: content-visibility hidden subtrees do not trigger resize observer
tests.propagation_fact: Changes inside content-visibility:hidden subtrees do not trigger ResizeObserver callbacks.
